name: Kirilma: Helix Horizon
storyline:
After a global collapse, you find yourself inside a massive structure belonging to Korxtech. You don’t remember who you are or why you came here. But the silence around you makes one thing clear: something has changed irreversibly.

KIRILMA: Helix Horizon is a story-driven adventure experience set in a dystopian sci-fi world, focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

As you move through abandoned floors, collapsed systems, and traces left behind, you gradually uncover the truth behind the devastation.
summary: Explore a dystopian sci-fi world in KIRILMA: Helix Horizon, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a collapsed world.
